original.description: A German Maschinengewehr 08 on its sled mount (Schlittenlafette), exhibited in the Braunschweigisches Landesmuseum. The Commons record's description is the photographer's: "Exhibit in the Braunschweigisches Landesmuseum, Braunschweig, Germany." Same museum, same photographer and the same day's visit as the Pickelhaube under its field cover already in the registry.
original.date: 18 November 2014 (the photograph); the object is an MG 08, the German heavy machine gun of 1914
original.archive: Braunschweigisches Landesmuseum, Braunschweig (the collection); photograph held on Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"; AttributionRequired false — the photographer released the photograph, and the object is out of copyright).

colorization.status: not colorized, and must not be — a modern colour photograph of the object.

content_policy: ok — a museum object on display; no casualties
caption: The Maschinengewehr 08 on its sled mount, the German heavy machine gun of 1914, in the Braunschweigisches Landesmuseum — a Maxim built under licence at Spandau.
notes: Verified 2026-08-25 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API (Artist, Credit, DateTimeOriginal, LicenseShortName, UsageTerms, AttributionRequired read from extmetadata). No `used_by`: the machine-gun card this was found for does not exist, because no admissible Belgian Maxim was found and a cross-army comparison missing one of the pack's four armies is not a comparison (docs/imagery-kit.md). Three of the four guns are in the registry — this one, the Vickers at York and the Hotchkiss at Verdun — and the card can be written the day Belgium's is.
credit: Photograph: Daderot, 2014, of an object in the Braunschweigisches Landesmuseum; via Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
